
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/zhuxiaoweb/p/19412328" title="发布于 2025-12-28 17:22">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">Nvm切换Node版本同时自动切换Npm、Yarn、Pnpm的缓存地址</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p>我们使用<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"><strong>Nvm</strong></span>，在切换<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"><strong>Node</strong></span>版本时，包管理工具（<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"><strong>Npm</strong></span>、<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"><strong>Yarn</strong></span>、<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"><strong>Pnpm</strong></span>）的缓存地址并不会因为<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"><strong>Node</strong></span>版本的改变而改变，<br>这就导致了可能因为<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"><strong>Node</strong></span>版本与依赖包不兼容而导致的项目运行问题。以下<strong><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">Shell</span></strong>脚本（本地系统：<span style="color: rgba(102, 102, 153, 1)">MacOs 26.2 (25C56)</span> 修改的<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"><strong>~/.zshrc</strong></span>文件）<br><br>可以实现在执行 “<span style="color: rgba(102, 102, 153, 1)"><strong>nvm use XXX</strong></span>” 时，自动为每个版本的<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"><strong>Node</strong></span>切换独立的缓存地址。</p>
<p><span style="font-size: 16px"><strong>一、修改文件：<span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">~/.zshrc：</span></strong></span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"># 启用 Zsh 的钩子功能
autoload </span>-U add-zsh-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">hook

# 统一函数：根据 Node.js 版本设置各包管理器的缓存路径
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">function</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> sync_package_manager_cache {
  # 获取当前 Node 版本（去掉 </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">v</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 前缀）
  local node_version</span>=$(node -v <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>&gt;/dev/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span> | <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">sed</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">s/^v//</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
  
  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> [ -n <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">$node_version</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> ]; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">then</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    # </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">. 设置 pnpm 存储路径
    local pnpm_store_path</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">$HOME/.pnpm-store/v3/node-$node_version</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">mkdir</span> -p <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">$pnpm_store_path</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    pnpm config set store</span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">dir</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">$pnpm_store_path</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> --global &gt; /dev/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>&gt;&amp;<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

    # </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">. 设置 npm 缓存路径
    local npm_cache_path</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">$HOME/.npm_cache/node-$node_version</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">mkdir</span> -p <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">$npm_cache_path</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    # 通过环境变量设置（优先级最高）
    export npm_config_cache</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">$npm_cache_path</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    # 同时写入全局配置
    npm config set cache </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">$npm_cache_path</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> --global <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>&gt;/dev/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

    # </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">. 设置 yarn (v1) 缓存路径
    local yarn_cache_path</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">$HOME/.yarn_cache/node-$node_version</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">mkdir</span> -p <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">$yarn_cache_path</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    # 通过环境变量设置
    export YARN_CACHE_FOLDER</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">$yarn_cache_path</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    # 如果 yarn 已安装，也写入其全局配置
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> command -v yarn &amp;&gt; /dev/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">then</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
      yarn config set cache</span>-folder <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">$yarn_cache_path</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> --global <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>&gt;/dev/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">fi</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

    # 可选：切换时显示提示（需要提示时可取消注释下一行）
    # </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">echo</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">缓存目录已切换至 Node.js $node_version 对应路径</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>
  <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">fi</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
}

# 将函数添加到 precmd 钩子，在每次显示命令提示符前执行
add</span>-zsh-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">hook precmd sync_package_manager_cache

# Shell 启动时立即执行一次，确保初始状态正确
sync_package_manager_cache</span></pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><span style="font-size: 16px"><strong>二、 修改保存文件以后执行生效：</strong></span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>source ~/.zshrc</pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><span style="font-size: 16px"><strong>三、验证是否生效：</strong></span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>nvm use <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">22</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">echo</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Node版本: $(node -v)</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">echo</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">npm缓存: $(npm config get cache)</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">echo</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">yarn缓存: $(yarn cache dir 2&gt;/dev/null || echo 'yarn未安装')</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">echo</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">pnpm存储: $(pnpm store path)</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

nvm use </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">24</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">echo</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Node版本: $(node -v)</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">echo</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">npm缓存: $(npm config get cache)</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">echo</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">yarn缓存: $(yarn cache dir 2&gt;/dev/null)</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">echo</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">pnpm存储: $(pnpm store path)</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span></pre>
</div>
